verdict.rationale: A government IP office could reasonably publish a public data API, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web search databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing tools (DPMAdirektWeb, DPMAdirektPro), with no documented API endpoints, key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. The robots.txt probe concerns crawling permissions, not an API.
